priced_in_stats.definition: day-0 move vs the previous close; further rise = highest close over the next 19 trading days vs the day-0 close (day 0 itself excluded)

returns.series: CL=F with roll days rebuilt as same-contract returns (EIA contract 1 and 2)

variance_risk_premium.method: OVX (the CBOE Crude Oil ETF Volatility Index, a 30-calendar-day implied vol from options on the USO ETF, not on CL futures, so it carries a basis to front-month WTI) vs realized vol over the next 20 trading days (about 29 calendar days), non-overlapping. Short-vol proxies: vol swap = IV - RV; variance swap per unit vega = (IV^2 - RV^2) / (2 IV). Timing: short-variance P&L regressed on OVX minus the model's forecast (Newey-West t), and rich = that spread above its trailing median.

vol_target_overlay.method: Weekly rebalanced long front-month WTI, rolled at each expiry (same-contract returns); position = min(cap, target vol / forecast vol), sized on the variance-consistent forecast. Trailing-vol sizing uses 22-day realized vol; costs on every unit of turnover. Sharpe differences use a stationary block bootstrap.

interval_80.method: adaptive conformal inference on out-of-sample log errors (Gibbs-Candes 2021)

live_record.promotion_rule: The challenger replaces the model of record if, on the first 52 independent resolved weeks where both were forecast, its mean QLIKE is lower with a one-sided Diebold-Mariano p below 0.10 (Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold, Student t with 51 degrees of freedom). The test is run once, on that fixed sample; a maintainer applies the verdict.
live_record.note: Each forecast is scored on the realized volatility of the five settlement-to-settlement returns after the first CL settlement (14:30 ET) at least an hour after it was issued and recorded, one session or more later than the backtest's window. The record is sealed just before each git commit; an entry not sealed more than five minutes before that settlement is marked late_commit and never scored, so every scored forecast was committed before any price it is scored on.
live_record.direction_note: Direction accuracy is not evidence of skill: on simulated returns with nothing to forecast, the backtest's noise floor is 75.5%, because a five-session realized vol is a noisy estimate that reverts toward its mean. QLIKE is the skill measure.
